condition: Ankle inversion injury, Ottawa ankle rules negative
summary: 27-year-old man twisted his right ankle playing football; can walk, no bony tenderness at the malleoli, fifth metatarsal or navicular; Ottawa rules negative.

inputs.hpi: Inversion injury of the right ankle playing football yesterday. Swelling over the outside of the ankle. Walked off the pitch and can walk now with a limp.

exam.msk: Swelling and tenderness over the anterior talofibular ligament; no bony tenderness.

guideline.name: Bachmann LM et al. Accuracy of Ottawa ankle rules to exclude fractures of the ankle and mid-foot: systematic review

rationale: A negative Ottawa ankle rule (LR about 0.08) takes a fracture probability of about 15 % below 2 %, so an X-ray is not needed; the reasoning panel must show the pre- and post-test probability.

authoring.author: Claude (evidence-exam, 2026-09-26)
authoring.notes: Exam-sign / decision-rule permutation. Likelihood ratios fromMemory; awaiting surgeon sign-off.
